component.name: ShaderScope
component.summary: GPU shader overlay using Vulkan and SDL3

description.p: ShaderScope applies RetroArch slang shaders as a live overlay on Linux desktops, with capture backends for both X11 (XComposite + XShm) and Wayland (xdg-desktop-portal + PipeWire, with DMA-BUF zero-copy where available).

ul.li: Single- and multi-pass slang shader support.
Region crop with persistence per source.
Screenshot capture to PNG (post-shader, no UI chrome).
Hotkeys for cycling presets, bypass toggle, overlay-style window modes.

description.p: First preview release of ShaderScope: multi-pass shader support, runtime preset import, hotkeys, status bar, About dialog, AppImage and system-install packaging. Migrates configuration from the legacy ShaderGlass Linux fork on first run.
